outputs.explanation: Panel A consists of pseudocoloured micrograph images (photoactivation time-lapse), not a plot, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.

Panel B shows scatter/line plots of normalized intensity over time where each red square/green diamond marker is an individual measured data point (not a summary bar), with fitted model curves overlaid. The insets similarly plot averaged time-course curves with error bars, which fall under the line-plot exemption (overlaying individual points on such dense time-series would be unreadable) and the main curves already show the underlying individual measurements.
